answer: Beacon Stamp. 1) Each user generates a unique pseudonym. 2) The echo service periodically broadcasts a random beacon, acting as a timestamp. 3) Users submit their pseudonym and the current beacon to the spiral service, creating a verifiable record of participation at that time. 4) The falcon service audits these submissions for duplicate pseudonyms. Cost is $0.05 x N. For N=1000 identities, the cost is $50. The mechanism fails if the echo service is compromised and broadcasts a manipulated beacon.
